source_reference.generator: None. The sheet is a Cycles render of a procedural Blender blockout; no image-generation model was used for this asset.

original_work: The preserved model-stage source introduced the topology, UVs, weights, 30-joint rig and five clips; this delivery rebuilt and rechecked them; the approved blockout supplied measured proportions, colours, parody hooks and (through its own construction functions) the hood opening, face, mask, eye, fringe, torso, belt, star, coil, cuff, heart and boot coordinates.

Original 1024 painted atlas generated with numpy in Blender Python (paint.py): the grin, teeth, tongue, blush and nose shade on the face, the dew-drop web on the hood (azimuthal crown map), the chest and back webs round the stars (torso front/back regions in the blockout arc-length coordinates), the iris, pupil and glints on the eyes and the finger grooves on the palms, all at the blockout decals' projected positions; flat sheet-colour tiles for everything else. No external texture.
Mesh, UV, transfer, validation and evidence utilities adapted from the WO111 demon-band-idol / rival-mayor / gadget-helper / golden-after-hours-rat scripts.
